titulo: Lam Research (Jan 2023): $2 billion buying back its own stock, about 1,300 positions. The math.
descripcion:
From the archive: Jan 2023. Not today's news.
Lam Research, Jan 25, 2023 (Lam Research, Form 8-K): "better align the Company’s cost structure with its outlook for the current economic environment"
Lam Research said in an SEC filing on Jan. 25, 2023 that it commenced a workforce reduction of approximately 1,300 employee positions. The buyback figure is from its fiscal 2023 Form 10-K.

Same fiscal year: $2 billion buying back its own stock, fiscal 2023. $2,017,012 thousand of treasury stock purchases in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 25, 2023), company-wide (cash flow statement, Form 10-K, reported in thousands).
The math: $2 billion in buybacks (2023) ÷ about 1,300 job cuts = about $1.5 million in buybacks per planned position cut.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the total spent on buybacks divided by the job count. The $2.017 billion is Lam Research's treasury stock purchases for fiscal 2023 (July 2022 to June 2023), company-wide. The 1,300 positions, about 7% of employees, are the filing's estimate. We are not saying one paid for the other.

Aligned with the outlook. The buyback had its own column. (Our take.)

Sources:
- SEC EDGAR · Lam Research, Jan 25, 2023: «the Company commenced a workforce reduction that is intended to better align the Company’s cost structure with its outlook for the current economic environment and future business opportunities» and «The Company expects the Restructuring Plan to entail a workforce reduction of approximately 1,300 employee positions» https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707549/000070754923000005/lrcx-20230123.htm
- SEC EDGAR · Lam Research, Aug 15, 2023: «Treasury stock purchases ( 2,017,012 ) ( 3,865,663 ) ( 2,697,704 )» https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707549/000070754923000102/lrcx-20230625.htm
